# Unsuccessful Search

#### Course: DSA with Python

## Unsuccessful Search

Suppose we have to find the index of element 20 (the target value) in the given list.

![Unsuccessful Search](data:image/png;base64,)

In this case, the linear search algorithm checks each element one by one.

Since this element is not present in the list, the algorithm ends after it reaches the end of the list. This is called an unsuccessful search.
